english.note: Use this when the absurdity is especially laughable or deserves mockery rather than just being unreasonable.

examples.english: He said he always came first, but he even got his own name wrong—that's farcical.
examples.traditional: 佢話自己次次考第一，點知連名都寫錯，真係可笑。
